items.title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
items.summary: Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round.
items.creator: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Nvidia reverses course and brings Jensen Huang back as CEO
items.summary: The stunning reversal was supported by senior officials in the U.S. government.
items.creator: Kirsten Korosec

items.title: Dutch privacy authority urges consumers not to buy ‘pervert glasses’
items.summary: The Netherlands' data protection agency said smart wearables violate people's privacy, get information wrong, and can result in unsafe situations.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker

items.title: Trump endorses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, says US has no evidence of wrongdoing
items.summary: The president cited the U.S. Attorney General in defending Huang's return, while urging Nvidia to continue its export-control investigation.
items.creator: Sarah Perez
